shots.text: He had no throne. He would not sit on anything that was not the centre of the world.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A vast empty hall with no floor. In the middle, standing on nothing: a figure of black glass with a crown-shaped gap for a face, the Heartstone's stolen light caught in its chest.

shots.text: Six of you. Always six. Do you know how tired I am of six?
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun turning toward the army; cracks in its glass bleeding red, then blue, then green.

shots.text:
Mirelle had seen a death at the end of the war. She told me later what it was.

It was the Seventh's.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Mirelle at the edge of the hall, blind eyes glowing teal, a small smile.
